audit_log_ref_check.name: audit_log_ref_check
audit_log_ref_check.value: "audit_log"."ref" is null or char_length("audit_log"."ref") between 1 and 120

audit_log_host_check.name: audit_log_host_check
audit_log_host_check.value: "audit_log"."host" is null or char_length("audit_log"."host") between 1 and 253

cost_entries_source_check.name: cost_entries_source_check
cost_entries_source_check.value: ("cost_entries"."run_id" is not null)::integer + ("cost_entries"."capture_id" is not null)::integer = 1

cost_entries_idempotency_check.name: cost_entries_idempotency_check
cost_entries_idempotency_check.value: ("cost_entries"."run_id" is not null and "cost_entries"."idempotency_key" = 'cost:' || "cost_entries"."run_id"::text || ':' || "cost_entries"."call_index"::text) or ("cost_entries"."capture_id" is not null and ("cost_entries"."idempotency_key" = 'teach:' || "cost_entries"."capture_id"::text || ':asr:' || ("cost_entries"."call_index" - 1)::text or "cost_entries"."idempotency_key" = 'teach:' || "cost_entries"."capture_id"::text || ':skill:' || "cost_entries"."call_index"::text))

memory_entries_shape_check.name: memory_entries_shape_check
memory_entries_shape_check.value: ("memory_entries"."doc" = 'user' and "memory_entries"."scope" = 'global' and "memory_entries"."agent_id" is null and cardinality("memory_entries"."visible_to") = 0) or ("memory_entries"."doc" = 'memory' and "memory_entries"."scope" = 'agent' and "memory_entries"."agent_id" is not null and cardinality("memory_entries"."visible_to") = 0) or ("memory_entries"."doc" = 'private' and "memory_entries"."scope" = 'private' and "memory_entries"."agent_id" is not null)

memory_versions_reason_check.name: memory_versions_reason_check
memory_versions_reason_check.value: "memory_versions"."reason" is null or char_length("memory_versions"."reason") between 1 and 200

model_prices_rates_check.name: model_prices_rates_check
model_prices_rates_check.value: "model_prices"."input_micro_usd_per_million" between 0 and 1000000000 and "model_prices"."cached_micro_usd_per_million" between 0 and 1000000000 and "model_prices"."output_micro_usd_per_million" between 0 and 1000000000 and "model_prices"."image_micro_usd_per_thousand" between 0 and 1000000000 and "model_prices"."audio_micro_usd_per_hour" between 0 and 1000000000

model_roles_routing_check.name: model_roles_routing_check
model_roles_routing_check.value: "model_roles"."routing" in ('fixed', 'auto') and ("model_roles"."routing" = 'fixed' or "model_roles"."hard_model" is not null) and ("model_roles"."role" = 'main' or ("model_roles"."routing" = 'fixed' and "model_roles"."hard_model" is null))

model_roles_main_shape_check.name: model_roles_main_shape_check
model_roles_main_shape_check.value: "model_roles"."role" <> 'main' or ("model_roles"."mode" = 'active' and "model_roles"."provider_id" is not null and "model_roles"."model" is not null and "model_roles"."use_main_key" = false)

model_roles_sam_shape_check.name: model_roles_sam_shape_check
model_roles_sam_shape_check.value: "model_roles"."role" <> 'sam' or (("model_roles"."mode" = 'off' and "model_roles"."provider_id" is null and "model_roles"."model" is null and "model_roles"."use_main_key" = false) or ("model_roles"."mode" = 'meta' and "model_roles"."provider_id" is not null and "model_roles"."model" is not null))

routines_schedule_check.name: routines_schedule_check
routines_schedule_check.value: char_length("routines"."schedule") between 1 and 200 and char_length("routines"."timezone") between 1 and 100 and jsonb_typeof("routines"."steps") = 'array'

run_meta_label_check.name: run_meta_label_check
run_meta_label_check.value: "run_meta"."label" is null or char_length("run_meta"."label") between 1 and 120

runs_sealed_check.name: runs_sealed_check
runs_sealed_check.value: ("runs"."signature" is null and "runs"."ended_at" is null and "runs"."step_count" is null and "runs"."head_hash" is null and "runs"."usage" is null) or ("runs"."signature" is not null and "runs"."ended_at" is not null and "runs"."step_count" is not null and "runs"."head_hash" is not null and "runs"."usage" is not null)
